newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates remain range-bound.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates remain range-bound.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates were traded between 6.00 and 11 percent on Tuesday, with majority of funds changing hands below 10 percent, dealers said.
Early bids and offers were quoted at 3.00 and 10 percent respectively, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
Some funds changed hands at 6.00 percent but then the offers rose to 11 percent, he said.
"In the mid-session, deals were struck at 9.00 and 10.00 percent," the dealer said.
